prompt: How many years had the then-Prime Minister of France been in office as PM when the first Shelby GT500 was built?
answer: The first Shelby GT500 was built in **1967**. France’s Prime Minister, **Georges Pompidou**, had taken office on **14 April 1962**, so he had been Prime Minister for **about five years**.
